choices.text: Make her your informant

effects.log: Nobody notices a tofu seller. She knows everything by noon. (-10 taels)

events.text: You have caught a would-be young hero snooping in your storehouse: a bold, hungry orphan called Fei Yan. Ding. [Villain Quest: Deliver a Monologue]. [Requirement: Explain your entire plan to the captive].

choices.text: Deliver the monologue

ok.log: Forty minutes. Fei Yan listens, rapt. At the end, Fei Yan is gone; the rope is cut. Your plan is very well known.

fail.log: You lose your place halfway. Fei Yan prompts you twice, then escapes.

choices.text: Refuse the monologue and hand Fei Yan to the magistrate

effects.log: [Quest Failed: Insufficient Drama]. Fei Yan spends a month in a cell, scowling.

choices.text: Feed Fei Yan and let them go

effects.log: Fei Yan eats three bowls, glares at you and climbs out of the window.

events.text: Fei Yan has told everyone your plan: the dockside warehouses, the forged deeds, all of it. To be fair, you told them very clearly. Ding. [The System recommends: a new plan]. [The System does not recommend: another monologue].

choices.text: Make a new plan

ok.log: The new plan works because everyone is busy watching the old one. (100 taels)

fail.log: The new plan is very like the old plan. Everyone notices.

choices.text: Find Fei Yan and offer a job

effects.log: Fei Yan says no. Then asks what the pay is. Then says no again, slower.

events.text: Old Ox Bai has been your henchman eleven years. Tonight he asks, twisting his cap, if he might retire to his brother's pear orchard. Ding. [Henchman Loyalty Event]. [Recommended: Deny].
events.arc: The Henchman Who Wanted to Go Home

choices.text: Let him go, with silver

effects.log: He weeps into his cap. [The System is appalled]. (-50 taels)

choices.text: Deny him

effects.log: He bows and goes back to the gate. He is very quiet now.

choices.text: One last job, then the orchard

effects.log: He agrees. The last job goes smoothly, as last jobs never do in stories.

events.text: A cart arrives from a pear orchard in the west: a hundred pears, wrapped one by one in paper. Under them a note in Ox Bai's slow hand: "If you ever want to stop, there is a room." The System files it under [Threats].
events.arc: The Henchman Who Wanted to Go Home

choices.text: Keep the note

effects.log: You keep it in your sleeve. It is the only thing in the lair that is not a threat.

choices.text: Share the pears with the henchmen

effects.log: Even the gate guards cry a little. Morale: excellent.

events.text: You make rice porridge. The iron ring on your finger grows warm. "That," says the old master in the ring, "is glue. In my day a disciple who made porridge like that was sent to sweep the latrines for a month."

choices.text: Ask him how to make it, then

effects.log: He talks you through it, step by step, with great bitterness. It is very good porridge.

choices.text: Eat it anyway, loudly

effects.log: "Disgusting," he says, as you finish the bowl. "Like a goat at a trough."

choices.text: Make it worse on purpose

effects.log: He is speechless for the first time since he woke. It lasts an hour.

events.text: The ring is warm again over the stove. "You remember the porridge," the old master says. "Now. Fish. I had a fish dish once, in a teahouse by the West Lake. I have thought about it for sixty years and forty years dead."

choices.text: Try to make it from his description

ok.log: He is quiet for a long time after the first bite. "Close," he says, at last, which from him is a hymn.

fail.log: "No," he says. "No. More vinegar. No. Less. No." It goes on until midnight.

choices.text: Buy the dish at a good teahouse

effects.log: He tastes it through you and says it is not as good as the one in his memory. Nothing is. (-8 taels)

events.text: War in the kitchen. Every meal you make, the old master criticises; every criticism, you make it worse. Today you serve him, through your own mouth, a stew of bitter melon and burnt garlic. He is ominously silent.

choices.text: Wait him out

effects.log: At last he laughs, a dry old rattle. "My master did this to me," he says. "I did it to my disciples. Truce?"

choices.text: Make a proper meal as a peace offering

effects.log: He grumbles that the salt is wrong. It is the most tender grumble you have ever heard.

events.text: A challenge in front of the whole courtyard: the spearman Kang Lei, two years your senior and very sure of himself. The ring grows warm. "Left foot back," says the old master. "He drops his elbow before he thrusts. Watch it."

choices.text: Fight with his voice in your ear

ok.log: He drops his elbow. You are already moving. Kang Lei sits down in the sand, astonished.

fail.log: "You saw it," the old master says, "and moved late. Again tomorrow."

choices.text: Tell him to be quiet: this one is yours

ok.log: You win alone. The ring is very warm all evening, the way a proud man goes red.

fail.log: You lose alone. The old master says nothing at all, which is kind.

choices.text: Decline the duel

effects.log: "Wise," says the old master, "and boring."

events.text: Kang Lei wants a rematch. He has been training his elbow for a year. The old master is delighted. "Good! Now he is worth fighting. This time I will tell you nothing until the third exchange."

choices.text: Fight

ok.log: On the third exchange the old master says one word, "Now", and you were already moving.

fail.log: Kang Lei wins fairly. The old master tells you why for two hours. You learn more than from any win.

choices.text: Offer to train with Kang Lei instead

effects.log: He is surprised and then glad. The old master coaches you both, though only you can hear him.

events.text: Kang Lei comes to you after your solo win with a jug of wine. "Who taught you?" he asks. The ring is warm. The old master says, in a very small voice, "You may tell him it was a very handsome old man."

choices.text: Tell Kang Lei it was a handsome old man

effects.log: Kang Lei laughs and does not believe you. The ring is warm and smug.

choices.text: Tell Kang Lei you taught yourself

effects.log: The ring goes cold for a day. Then the old master says, "Well. That is also true."

events.text: In the market a woman is selling hairpins of white jade carved like plum blossoms. The ring goes cold, then warm. "My wife had one," says the old master. "I gave it to her. I have not thought of her in thirty years."

choices.text: Buy the hairpin

effects.log: He does not thank you. He is quiet all day, the warm quiet. (-25 taels)

choices.text: Ask him about her

effects.log: She was a better sword than him, he says, and she laughed at his poems, and she died young.

choices.text: Walk on without a word

effects.log: He says nothing more about it. But that night you dream of plum blossoms.

events.text: "She is buried in a village called Three Willows," the old master says, "by a river, under a plum tree I planted. I never went back. I was too busy being famous. Would you take me? It is only ten days' walk."

choices.text: Take him there

effects.log: The plum tree is still there, enormous. The ring is warm all the way there and all the way back.

choices.text: Promise to, one day

effects.log: "One day," he says. "I know about one day. I said it for forty years."

events.text: At the grave in Three Willows you lay a spray of plum blossom at the tree's roots. The old master is silent so long you think he has gone to sleep. Then: "Thank you. She would have liked you. She liked fools."

choices.text: Stay the night by the tree

effects.log: He talks about her until dawn. You learn a sword form she invented. He never knew it until he told it to you.

choices.text: Leave quietly

effects.log: You walk back slowly. Once, on the road, the ring hums a tune you have never heard.

events.text: "I was born in the mountains," says the old master, "I died in the mountains, and I never once saw the sea. People said it was like a lake. I do not believe it. No lake is so big that a whole life cannot see across it."
events.arc: He Wants to See the Sea

choices.text: Promise to take him

effects.log: "Hah," he says. But the ring is warm.

choices.text: Ask why he never went

effects.log: "Too busy fighting," he says. "Nobody sends you a challenge from the sea."

choices.text: Tell him it is only water

effects.log: He says nothing for a week. You feel like a monster.

events.text: The coast road, ten days in. The air smells of salt, which the old master has never smelled and thinks is a poison. "Turn back," he says, "it is a trap." You keep walking. Over the last hill there is a sound like a city breathing.
events.arc: He Wants to See the Sea

choices.text: Walk him to the water

effects.log: He does not say anything at all. The ring is as warm as a hand.

choices.text: Let him hear it before he sees it

effects.log: You close your eyes at the top of the hill. He weeps, you think. A ring cannot weep, but you feel it.

events.text: You come back to the shore every year at the same season now. The old master calls it his teahouse. He has opinions about every wave: this one is lazy, this one is proud, this one is like his third disciple, all noise.
events.arc: He Wants to See the Sea

choices.text: Sit with him all afternoon

effects.log: He tells you the sea is the only master he ever met who could not be beaten. It does not seem to bother him.

choices.text: Swim out, with him on your hand

ok.log: He shouts in your head the whole way, half terror, half joy.

fail.log: A wave rolls you back up the beach. He laughs until he coughs, though he has no lungs.

events.text: Abbot Wuyan of the hill temple plays weiqi with anyone who climbs the thousand steps, and has not lost in thirty years. The ring is very warm. "Sit," says the old master. "I want to play him. You be my hands."

choices.text: Play his moves

ok.log: The abbot loses by half a stone and stares at you for a long time. "You play like a dead man I knew," he says.

fail.log: The abbot wins by two stones. The old master is very quiet and then demands a rematch.

choices.text: Play your own moves

effects.log: You lose by forty stones. The old master is disgusted and tells you so for the whole thousand steps down.

events.text: Abbot Wuyan sends a novice down for you. He would like to know, he says, where you learned to play the opening called the Cracked Bell, which only one man in the world ever played, and that man died forty years ago.

choices.text: Tell the abbot the truth

effects.log: The abbot laughs until he cries. "That old cheat," he says, "he still owes me a cup of tea."

choices.text: Say it came to you in a dream

effects.log: The abbot nods slowly. "He always was a dream," he says, "and a nightmare at the board."

choices.text: Let the old master answer through you

effects.log: You say the words he gives you. The abbot goes pale, then bows to the ring.

events.text: For a whole season the iron ring is cold. No lessons, no complaints about your cooking, no opinions on your friends. You catch yourself talking to it at night anyway, the way you would to an empty chair.

choices.text: Keep training as if he were watching

effects.log: You keep the dawn hours he set you. It is very quiet.

choices.text: Take the season off

effects.log: You sleep late and eat badly. Nobody says a word.

choices.text: Burn incense for him

effects.log: The smoke curls around the ring. Nothing. (-2 taels)

events.text: One morning the ring is warm again. "I was resting," says the old master, crossly, as if you had accused him. "Even the dead must sleep. Now. What have you done with my dawn hours?"

choices.text: Show him

effects.log: He watches the whole form and says nothing. Then: "Hm. Better than when I was awake."

choices.text: Tell him you missed him

effects.log: "Sentimental," he says. The ring is warm for a week.

choices.text: Pretend you did not notice he was gone

effects.log: He snorts. "Liar," he says, and starts the morning lesson.

events.text: Ding. [Haggling: 99%]. One more haggle and the bar turns gold. The only seller in sight is Old Lady Fan with a basket of turnips, who has haggled in this market for sixty years and has never once lost.

choices.text: Haggle with Old Lady Fan

ok.log: Two coppers off. [Haggling: GOLD]. Old Lady Fan stares at you, then smiles for the first time in sixty years.

fail.log: You walk away with turnips at twice the price and a sense of having been taught. (-1 taels)

choices.text: Find an easier seller

effects.log: A nervous boy selling eggs. The bar fills. It feels cheap.

choices.text: Pay full price and keep the bar at 99%

effects.log: Old Lady Fan looks at you as if you are ill. (-1 taels)

events.text: Old Lady Fan has been asking for you. She is retiring from the market. She would like, she says, to pass on her secrets to the only person who ever got two coppers off her turnips.

choices.text: Learn from her

effects.log: It takes a month. Most of her secrets are about listening. [Perk deepened].

choices.text: Buy her whole stock as a farewell

effects.log: She charges you full price, out of principle. (-5 taels)

events.text: Ding. [Napping: 100%]. [Napping has turned GOLD]. [New Perk: Restful Sleep]. It is the first bar you ever filled. Not Sword, not Study. Napping. The System sounds faintly embarrassed for both of you.

choices.text: Celebrate with a nap

effects.log: The best nap of your life. The willow approves.

choices.text: Swear to fill a serious bar next

effects.log: You train at dawn the next day. You also nap after. The perk is very good.

choices.text: Tell no one

effects.log: It is shown on your status, in gold, for anyone who can see such things. Nobody can.

events.text: A wandering physician, Doctor Ning, notices that you sleep like a stone and wake like a spring. He wants to know how. His patients cannot sleep. He is a little desperate.

choices.text: Teach his patients to nap

effects.log: Twelve patients under twelve willows. Ding. [Teaching: 30%].

choices.text: Sell him the secret

effects.log: You write "lie down" on a slip of paper. He pays. (30 taels)

events.text: Years on, your Sword bar turns gold at last, after hundreds of mornings. The System says: [Congratulations. Sword: GOLD]. Then, quietly: [Napping still ranks higher in your records]. You are not sure if it is joking.

choices.text: Nap to celebrate

effects.log: Under the willow, with a sword across your knees. Two gold bars. Both earned.

choices.text: Train again at once

effects.log: The System notes a new bar: [Not Resting: 4%].

events.text: You bump into a porter and say sorry. Ding. [Apologising: 87%]. Eighty-seven. You stand in the street wondering how many times you have said sorry in your life, and to whom, and how the System has been counting.

choices.text: Look at the full list

effects.log: A whole scroll of sorries. Most of them to a cat you used to know.

choices.text: Stop apologising for a year

effects.log: It is very hard. You bite your tongue at every door.

choices.text: Apologise to the System for being so sorry

effects.log: [Apologising: 88%]. The System does not know what to say.

events.text: The list has one name on it you never said sorry to: Cheng Hu, a friend from long ago, after a quarrel about nothing. He lives two towns away. The System's bar sits at 99%.

choices.text: Walk two towns and say it

effects.log: [Apologising: GOLD]. Cheng Hu says he was sorry too. You drink until midnight.

choices.text: Write a letter

effects.log: [Apologising: GOLD]. Cheng Hu writes back three words: "Me too. Idiot."

events.text: A year without saying sorry. You have been rude to a tailor, a monk and a goose. Ding. [New bar discovered: Not Apologising: 41%]. [Perk preview: You seem confident]. You are not sure that is a good perk.

choices.text: Fill it anyway

effects.log: People step out of your way in the street. Some of them glare.

choices.text: Go back and apologise to the goose

effects.log: [Apologising: 88%]. The goose accepts.

events.text: You sit by the river with a line. Ding. [Fishing: 12%]. Then a new bar you have never seen: [Patience: 3%]. Old Tao, who fishes the next rock along and has never caught anything, says, "You will hate that one."

choices.text: Keep sitting

effects.log: [Patience: 3%]. It does not move. You sit until sunset.

choices.text: Ask Old Tao what his is at

effects.log: "I have never had a bar in my life," he says, "and I have never been in a hurry."

choices.text: Give up and go to the market

effects.log: [Patience: 2%]. It went down. You did not know they could go down.

events.text: A year of afternoons beside Old Tao. You have caught nine fish. He has caught none. Your Patience bar has crept to 61%, and you have started to notice the river instead of the line.

choices.text: Ask him why he fishes without bait

effects.log: "Because then I am only sitting by the river," he says, "and that is enough."

choices.text: Leave the line at home and just sit

effects.log: [Patience: 70%]. You are surprised how much faster it fills.

events.text: Old Tao's rock is empty this spring. His grandson brings you his rod, which never had a hook on it. Ding. [Patience: 100%]. [Patience has turned GOLD]. It filled, you realise, on the day you stopped looking at it.

choices.text: Fish from his rock

effects.log: No hook. No bait. A very long afternoon. It is enough.

choices.text: Teach his grandson to sit

effects.log: The boy fidgets for a month. Then, one day, he does not.

events.text: Ding. A bar appears you did not ask for: [Being Lied To: 64%]. You did not know there was such a bar. You do some counting, and realise it has been filling in the background for years.

choices.text: Go through who has lied to you

effects.log: The landlord. The horse dealer. A sweet-faced cousin. You stop before the list gets worse.

choices.text: Refuse to think about it

effects.log: You put it out of your mind. It stays at 64%.

events.text: You notice now when someone lies: the bar twitches. Today it twitches when the cloth merchant Yang tells you his silk is from Suzhou, and again when your neighbour says she loves your cooking.

choices.text: Call out the merchant

effects.log: Yang turns red and knocks the price down by twenty taels. (20 taels)

choices.text: Let the neighbour's lie stand

effects.log: Some lies are presents. You keep this one.

events.text: The bar reaches 100% on an ordinary afternoon and turns gold. [New Perk: Clear Eyes]. In the same breath, you notice a small lie you have told yourself for years, and the bar does not move, because it only counts others.

choices.text: Face the lie

effects.log: It takes an evening and a jug of tea. You feel ten years younger.

choices.text: Leave it: some lies keep you standing

effects.log: You keep it. You are kinder now, to yourself and to liars.
